description: This file contains unit tests for URL normalization functions. It tests various aspects of URL parsing and normalization, including schemes, authorities, ports, escapes, high-bit characters, UTF-8, user info, lengths, dots, and URL equivalence. The tests are implemented using assertions with checks for expected normalized URLs and properties.

methods.name: void check_url_normalizable(const char * url,unsigned int normalizable)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is normalizable based on whether url_normalize returns non-NULL for the input URL.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url(const char * url,const char * expect)
methods.description: Checks if the normalized URL matches the expected string.

methods.name: void compare_normalized_urls(const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
methods.description: Compares two URLs after normalization to see if they are equivalent (or not) based on the 'equal' flag.

methods.name: void check_normalized_url_length(const char * url,size_t len)
methods.description: Checks if the length of the normalized URL matches the expected length.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__scheme(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL schemes, verifying normalizability and correct normalization behavior for schemes and scheme-like strings.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__authority(void)
methods.description: Unit test for URL authority components, including user info, host, and authority-related normalizations.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port(void)
methods.description: Unit test for port normalization, including valid, invalid, and edge cases for port numbers.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__port_normalization(void)
methods.description: Test for normalization of port numbers with leading zeros and boundary values.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__general_escape(void)
methods.description: Test decoding and normalization of percent-encoded characters and unreserved characters.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__high_bit(void)
methods.description: Test normalization of URLs containing high-bit (non-ASCII) characters encoded in percent notation.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__username_pass(void)
methods.description: Test normalization involving username and password percent-encoding.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__length(void)
methods.description: Test to verify the computed length of normalized URLs.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__dots(void)
methods.description: Test normalization of dot segments in URL paths.

methods.name: void test_urlmatch_normalization__equivalents(void)
methods.description: Tests URL equivalence after normalization for case-insensitive schemes and other normalizations.

ctags.name: check_url_normalizable
ctags.pattern: /^static void check_url_normalizable(const char *url, unsigned int normalizable)$/

ctags.name: compare_normalized_urls
ctags.signature: (const char * url1,const char * url2,unsigned int equal)
